'''Docking bay 77''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Voos]].<ref name="IDC" /> [[Rai-Kalei]] berthed his ship, the [[Mayjeln (freighter)|''Mayjeln'']] there.<ref name="SWJ4">{{JournalCite|4|A Deal Gone Sour}}</ref> The [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] was owned by [[Voos]], who made a few alterations to the docking bay. Keeping your ship here cost 2 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a day. Restocking consumables cost 10 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per one person's worth of supplies and [[Fuel cell/Legends|Fuel cells]] were recharged at 10 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per cell. A few minutes in the [[refresher booth]] cost 10 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a bad [[autochef]] meal cost 5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="PSG" />
